title.narrative: ICRC operations by the Islamic Republic of Iran Delegation(2024 Unaudited)

description.narrative: In Iran, the ICRC promotes IHL and works with the authorities in Iran and Iraq to address the consequences of the 1980-1988 Iran-Iraq war, particularly the issue of missing persons. We work with the Iranian Red Crescent and maintain a logistics capacity to support ICRC operations in the region.
